create_commit_scheduler: create a CommitScheduler to upload a local folder to the Hugging Face Hub at regular intervals
run_commit_scheduler_context_manager: run a CommitScheduler as a context manager to upload a local folder and trigger last commit on exit
test_commit_scheduler_trigger: test the CommitScheduler.trigger method to immediately push changed files to the Hub
review_commit_scheduler_push_to_hub: review the CommitScheduler.push_to_hub method that uploads only changed files since last commit
summarize_partial_file_io: summarize the PartialFileIO class that reads only the first part of a file to avoid uploading data still being written
